F1: The Quarkus server picks its crypto provider explicitly with `CryptoIntegration.setProvider` (KeycloakRecorder.java:214), so auto-detection only matters for the misconfiguration of having several full providers on the classpath at once.
F2: asn1derToConcatenatedRS` only receives DER output from the JDK's own `Signature.sign()` when signing, so the malformed sequence lengths described cannot actually reach it.
